name: HTTP status explainer
summary: Explain HTTP status codes and network errors
author: friday-core
description: Explains the common HTTP status codes (200 to 511, with the Cloudflare 52x family) and the error names that appear in logs (ENOTFOUND, ECONNRESET, ETIMEDOUT, ECONNREFUSED, EADDRINUSE, CERT_HAS_EXPIRED, UNABLE_TO_VERIFY_LEAF_SIGNATURE and more) with what to try. A status outside the list is reported as not covered, never guessed.
